verdict.rationale: Eqvista is an equity management SaaS platform, where in-product AI insights are a fair question, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only deterministic tools: round modeling, waterfall analysis, real-time valuation views and reports. Nothing documents AI-generated insights or suggestions, and the llms.txt file describes the site for external AI rather than adding an in-product AI capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
